code_artifact.explanation: Returns the built-in sum of the integer list directly; sum already yields 0 for an empty iterable, so the empty-list boundary case now returns 0 as required. Pure function, no printing, file I/O, or external dependencies.

changes.empty-list-returns-none: Removed the `if values else None` conditional and return `sum(values)` directly, so an empty list now yields 0 instead of None.
